__NOTOC__
<ic>To appoint an Imperial Citizen to the position of Imperial Consul.<br><br>
<i>Proposed by Segura, Seconded by Hercynia. </i></ic>

===Overview===
* This motion appoints a citizen to the position of Imperial Consul.

===Date===
* Summer 381YE

===Campaign Outcome===
* Aureliana Perpetua Nicasia Saverio di Sarvos was appointed.
